name: claude_worktree
description: Create a git worktree and launch Claude Code to implement a feature in any project. Call when user says 'create worktree in [project] for X', 'new branch in transcribe for Y'. Supports: transcribe (default), transcribe-v1, or custom path.

project_path.description: Project to work on. Can be: '$PROJECT_ROOT' (default), '$PROJECT_ROOT/../transcribe-rs' (v1), or any other git repo path. If user just says 'transcribe', use v2 path. Replace $PROJECT_ROOT with your actual project path.

branch_name.description: Git branch name in kebab-case (e.g., 'add-led-status', 'fix-audio-bug'). Auto-generate from task: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens, remove special chars.

task_description.description: Clear description of the feature/fix. Will be given to Claude Code. Example: 'Add LED status indicator that shows when recording is active'.

workspace.description: Optional Hyprland workspace number (1-10). Leave empty for current workspace.
